The SVG path uses two elliptical arc commands with the same radii (19.21, 19.21), large-arc flags set to 1, and sweep flags set to 0, forming a closed shape. Since both radii are equal, it is drawing arcs of a circle, not an ellipse. The path starts and ends at the same point after two arcs, creating a full circle.  

Final answer: (A)
